name: restamp
title: The old edge restamps a replay after a two-day outage: the consumer's check (received_at +- 1 day) misses the original, and central holds the request twice
timing: day = the edge's wall clock in days; custody(p) = the day p entered the durable buffer (day 0)

steps.action: take request 1 from the buffer (stamp: custody day 0), PUT e1/000; S3 commits it
the incarnation dies with the 200 in flight: request 1 is never acked and stays in the buffer
the edge is down for HORIZON + 1 = 2 days
FATAL: replay request 1, stamped with the exporter's clock (day 2), not its custody day
PUT e2/000; S3 commits the copy
check e2/0 over days 1..3: the original (day 0) is out of range

violated.expression: every committed copy's stamp == custody(p); central.get(p) <= 1

design.guard: STAMP_AT_CUSTODY: stamped(...) writes custody(p) for every incarnation
design.effect: step 6 stamps day 0; the check at step 8 reads days -1..1, finds the day-0 copy (dedupHit) and skips it: central[1] = 1 at HORIZON 1 and at HORIZON 0 (receivedDesign, receivedDesignNoHorizon)
design.code: D19 (2026-09-27): received_at is the Quiver WAL write (Rust, patch 0003) or the s3pq enqueue (Go, x-s3pq-received-at); replay_received.sh: 3/3 replays after a 4-day outage skipped

dropped: the second ack attempt and anything after the duplicate; step 3 is narrative (the model's incarnation simply never receives the 200)
